description: What the mission summary says about a landing zone, as frontend/src/components/MissionSummary.jsx computes it: area (square feet, rounded) and capacity for an aircraft, and the call the slope tile makes (frontend/src/feature/terrain/slopeCall.js). `profile` is a key into planning/aircraft.json's `profiles`, or null for the default UH-60L. `windLimits`: slopeLimitsFor(wind), the UH-60 slope limits (15° nose up, 6° nose down, 15° cross slope) less 2° for every full 5 knots of steady wind, never below 0, and nose down 0 above 15 knots; a wind of null is no report, the limits not reduced. A wind is {speedKts, fromDeg (the direction it blows from, 0..359 true, or null), variable}. `landingHeading`: landingHeadingOf(flight data's landing_hdg), its leading integer as JavaScript's parseInt reads it (no radix, so 0x is hexadecimal; String(value) first, so a number is its digits and true is no number), as 0..359, or null when there is none (a case without landingHdg has no such key; null is not 000). `ground`: tables of byHeading, each entry [heading, noseHighMaxDeg, noseLowMaxDeg, crossSlopeMaxDeg]; a `slope` case names one (terrainData is then {stats: {maxDeg}, byHeading: [{heading, noseHighMaxDeg, noseLowMaxDeg, crossSlopeMaxDeg}...]}) or gives terrainData itself. `slope`: slopeCallFor(terrainData, {landingHdg, wind}). A slope is over its limit only when greater than it, compared in tenths of a degree; LIMIT EXCEEDED when one is at the landing heading (the recommended one with no landing heading), else CAUTION above 10° of stats.maxDeg, else LANDING. The recommended heading is a multiple of 5: of those within limits, the closest to the wind's direction when its speed is above 0 and it is not variable and has a direction, else the closest to the landing heading, else the one whose worst excess is least (offDeg: how far it is from the wind's direction or the landing heading, null with neither); with none within, the one whose worst excess is least, then the closest as before (overDeg: by how much, limit: which). Closeness is the short way round; every tie goes to the smaller heading; a tie between limits names the first of nose up, nose down, cross. byHeading counts only when it has every heading 0..359 with three numbers of 0 or more (the first of a heading given twice); without it (an older server) nothing is judged by heading: HEADING REQUIRED at 15° or more.
